system.description:
Cursed item (seems a shield +1). It is a shield +1, but a ranged attack against any creature within 10ft of you is made against you instead.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
system.unidentifiedDescription:
Medium, one hand. Sturdy (hard to break); Conductive (Disadvantage on saves against lightning).

A shield +1.
